lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs nas chos kyi sku la thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi spyan rang bzhin rnam dag gi snang ba la shar ba'i dus na rgya mtshor chu bran 'dus pa'am/ lan tshwa chu la thim pa lta bur gyur pas/ rig stong dbyer mi phyed pa'i dus na/ ye shes kyi spyan la sgrib pa med par phyogs med kyi ye shes chen po ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa ste/ mi 'dra ba dang mi mthun pa med pas nyag gcig rang gsal 'dzin med du gnas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdor na gdod ma'i gzhi ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum po de yin de/ /thal 'gyur las/ grol sa thag ma gang yin pa'o/ /zhes pas gong du rgya cher bstan zin pas spros pas chog go / gnyis pa de las longs spyod rdzogs sku'i 'char lugs ni/ nang gsal chos sku'i gdangs las 'gro ba 'dul byed du thugs rje g.yos pa las/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas chu'i zla ba lta bu mtshan dang dpe byad kyi 'khor lor rang byon te/ sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'gro ba'i don rgyun mi 'chad pa nyid thal 'gyur las/

(< a > longs spyod sku la sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan dang ni phrin las so/ /sku ni snang la rang bzhin med ) / gsal dang gsal byed rig pas khyab/ /gsung ni rang byung rang snang dang*/ /spro bsdu snang ba'i 'khor lo 'o/ /thugs ni rgyun chad med gzigs dang*/ /mkhyen pa'i rtsal dang dgongs pa 'o/ /yon tan mtshan dpe rdzogs pa la/ /dgongs gsal mngon shes rdzogs pa 'o/ /phrin las chos kyi 'khor lo las/ /phyi nang gsang ba rnam spros te/ /so so'i rigs kyi sangs rgyas dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang*/ /rang byung ljags las rnam spros te/ /'khor lo rang gi ngo bos ston/ / ces so/ /de'ang sku snang la rang bzhin med pa gsung rang byung gi yi ge drug ljags kyi dbang po las spros pas/ gang la gang 'dul gyi chos sangs rgyas dang sems can kun la khyab par sgrogs pa/ thugs rje ye shes lnga'i mtshan nyid rgyun chad med pas sems can la gzigs pa'o/ /longs sku la thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes lnga thad kar rang gi 'khor la gzigs pa'o/ /de'ang chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis gdod ma'i ngang las mi g.yo bar mdzad/ me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis nang du mkhyen pa ma 'gags par mdzad/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis gnyis su med pa'i chos la longs spyod/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis phyi nang gi shes bya ma 'dres par mkhyen/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyis mdzad pa phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' klas par rgyun mi 'chad pa'o//de'ang chos sku ltar nang gsal du med la/ sprul sku ltar phyir gsal rags pa'i yul spyod byed du med kyang*/ thad kar gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i ngang la thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thugs rje rig pa'i char bzhugs so/ /ye shes 'od kyi sbubs na snang byed chu zla'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i ston par gzhi thog nas 'phags pa rang byon pas longs sku zhes bya'o/ /rgyas par ni sngar bstan pas mi spro'o/

/gsum pa de las sprul pa'i sku mngon par snang ba ni/ /longs sku'i gdangs las rang bzhin sprul pa'i skus phyogs bcur las dag pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sa la gnas pa rnams kyi don mdzad la/ de'i gdangs las 'gro ba 'dul ba sprul pa'i skus 'gro ba drug tu thub pa drug gi rnam par sprul te don mdzad pa ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgyar shākya thub pa bye ba phrag brgyas sems can gyi don mdzad pa bzhin no/ /de las ma dag pa'i sprul sku 'gyed pa ni/ skye ba dang*/ rga ba dang*/ na ba dang*/ 'chi ba dang*/ bzo sna tshogs dang*/ lam po che dang*/ ljon shing dang*/ 'bab chu dang*/ rdzing dang*/ nya bo che dang*/ nor bu dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ khyab 'jug dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ brgya byin dang*/ bram ze dang*/ bu mo dang*/ khye'u dang*/ ri dwags dang skyed mos tshal la sogs pa gang la gang mkho zhing gang gis 'dul ba de'i gzugs su sprul nas sems can gyi don rgya che la rgyun mi 'chad cing thabs la mkhas pa'i mdzad pa'o/ /'o na sngar gyi longs sku dang*/ rang bzhin sprul pa'i sku gnyis kas byang chub sems dpa'i sar gnas pa'i don byed pa 'dra'o snyam na/ mi 'dra ste/ sngar gyi longs skus rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par snang ba la chos ston pa ltar snang yang*/ gdul bya dang 'dul byed ma yin te/ btags grol las/ nyid las mi gzhan sems dpa'i snod/ /ces pas/ rang bzhin sprul sku'i sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa'i don byed pa'o/ /de ltar sprul pa'i sku de'i sku ni gdul bya dang mthun par mtshan dpes brgyan pa'am mtshan ma med pa'o/ /gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs drug cu la sogs pas rang rang gi snang ba dang mthun par chos ston pa'o/ / thugs ni phyi rol yul gyi rnam pa spyod pas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes te/ /chos nyid ji lta ba mkhyen nas don dam pa'i chos zab pa zhi ba gcig tu spros pa dang bral bar gsung zhing*/

chos can sna tshogs pa ma 'dres par mkhyen nas kun rdzob kyi chos las dang las kyi rnam par smin pa dang*/ lam dang 'gro ba'i gnas la sogs pa spang blang du mas 'gro ba 'dul ba'o/ /yon tan ni mkhyen rab bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /phrin las ni mdzad pa du mas sems can thar par 'dren pa la lhun grub tu 'byung ba ste/ thal 'gyur las/ sprul pa'i sku yang sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rnam pa lnga/ /sku ni mtshan dang dpe byad la/ /gdul bya gang 'dul lus sprul te/ /gsung ni tshigs sbyor legs pa la/ /tshangs pa'i dbyang ni yan lag drug /thugs ni shes bya'i ye shes gnyis/ / rang gzhan don gnyis rdzogs par gnas/ /yon tan mkhyen pa rdzogs pa dang*/ / phrin las phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /mdzad pa ma lus rdzogs pa 'o/ /phun sum tshogs pa lngar gnas so/ /zhes so/ /de'ang gdul bya yod na thams cad du de dang mthun par skad cig la snang la/ med na sprul sku longs skur thim/ longs sku gdod ma'i gzhi chos sku'i ngang du thim nas nang gsal nyid du lhun gyis grub bo/ /yang gdul bya snang na skad cig la sku gsum mam dgu /gcig las gcig mched de sems can gyi don rgyun mi 'chad par gdod ma'i kun tu bzang po bzhin mdzad do/ /mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'dzin chags rdos pa dang bcas pa sangs nas yon tan phrin las su rgyas te/ sku lnga'i 'dzin pa stongs nas/ thog ma'i gzhi ka dag chen por rang grol te/ rang shar las/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'khor ba sangs/ /ye shes sku nyid don la rgyas/ /sangs rgyas zhes kyang de la bya/ /zhes so/ /de ltar sangs rgyas pa'i sku lnga ni/ chos sku spros pa dang bral ba/ /longs sku mtshan dper gsal ba/ /sprul sku sna tshogs su snang ba/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku ni de dag gi chos nyid/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku ni dag pa gnyis ldan te/ /rang bzhin gdod ma nas dri ma med cing glo bur gyi dri ma rang ngo shes pas dag pa'o/

/mngon par byang chub pa'i sku ni/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje'i phrin las 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar sku lnga'i rang bzhin gdod ma'i gzhi la mthar phyin pa ni rdzogs pa chen po rang bzhin lhun grub kyi 'bras bu gdod ma ka dag gi sa la/ gzhi ji bzhin par sangs rgyas byang chub phyir mi ldog pa'i ye shes brnyes pa zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi don la/ zab gter gyi phan yon bstan/ gter 'byung gi lo rgyus bshad/ smon lam gyi mjug bsdu ba gsum las/ dang po phan yon bshad/ chos kyi che ba brjod/ lta ba'i tshul bshad pa dang gsum las/ dang po mthong grol khyad par du 'phags pa'i phan yon/ dge sdig phan gnod dang bral ba'i phan yon/ 'di las gzhan gyis mi grol ba'i phan yon/ 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i phan yon/ mkha' 'gros bu bzhin skyong ba'i phan yon dang lnga las/ dang po klong gsal las/ rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ / mthong ba tsam gyis shes pa dang*/ /shes pa tsam gyis grol bar 'gyur/ /mngon sum gnad 'di sus mthong ba/ khams gsum ldog pa ma yin no/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa btags grol las/ rgyud 'di ma rtogs dge ba bcu/ /spyad kyang 'khor ba las mi grol/ /de sngar mtshams med lnga spyad kyang*/ /'di 'phrad ngan song ltung mi srid/ /'di rig g.yo med skyes bu de/ /bsgom mi dgos te mthong grol 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ don gsal me long las/ / mngon sum gnad 'di sus mthong ba/ /chos nyid bar dor 'tshang rgya'o/ /ci'i phyir 'di ni ye shes dngos/ /mthong bas shes grol dus mnyam 'gyur/ /ci'i phyir theg pa gzhan dag gis/ /lo stong bsgoms kyang 'di mi mthong*/ /'dis ni skad cig nyid la mthong*/ /lo stong sdig pa spyad pas kyang*/ /'di nyid lo drug nyams blangs na/ /lhag ma med par 'tshang rgya'o/ /ci'i phyir ngo bo cir mthong yin/ / rig pa'i ye shes ngo bo la/

/sdig pa'i skyon gyis gos pa med/ / dge ba byas kyang phan ma btags/ /rig pa dge sdig don las 'das/ / zhes so/ /gsum pa btags grol las/ /pha rol phyin bcu snying po'i rgyud/ / yang dag rgyud 'di ma rtogs na/ /dus gsum kun tu sangs mi rgya/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*/ /'di la btags grol sangs rgyas te/ / sku lnga 'gro don lhun gyis grub/ /rang rig rnam dag sa gcig la/ /theg pa kun 'dus sa lam rdzogs/ /zhes pa dang*/ don gsal las/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /gnad 'di ma rtogs dge ba bcu/ /spyad kyang 'khor ba las mi grol/ / sngar dus mtshams med lnga byas kyang*/ /'di 'phrad ngan song ltung mi srid/ /'di dang btags grol gnyis sbrel na/ /lo drug phung po lhag med 'gro/ /'di med gang zag gzhan spyod pa/ /bskal par nyan bsam bsgoms bsgrubs kyang*/ / bskal par sangs rgyas re ba med/ /ci'i phyir mngon sum gnad ma rtogs/ / theg gsum rim dgu'i chos rnams kyis/ / 'di nyid don la reg pa med/ /'di ni kun las khyad par 'phags/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa de nyid las/ 'di dang tshig gis 'brel ba yang*/ /skye ba gsum du mi thogs grol/ /sgra tsam rna bar thos pa yang*/ /tha mal skye ba 'dis chod 'gyur/ /mngon sum gnad 'di sus mthong ba/ /chos nyid bar dor 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ snod spel ba'i dus btag pa las/ yang gsang snying thig 'di la sus spyod pa/ /sngon dus las can skye mtha' min re kan/ / mngal du mi 'jug tshe gcig sangs rgyas yin/ /'di nyid bris sam bcangs pas sangs rgyas 'thob/ /lan cig bka' shog mthong ba thams cad kyang*/ /o rgyan smon lam mthu yis ngan song khegs/ /dbang thob tsam gyis pad+ma can du skye/ /nyams su len pas 'bras thob smos ci dgos/ /'di la spyod tshad o rgyan nga yi sras/ /skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang sems yin/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa me long las/ gzhi la shes rab lhun gyis grub/

/thabs kyis mngon sum skad cig la/ / mthong ste grol 'gyur the tshom med/ /de phyir mkha' 'gro dngos kyi ston/ /'di la spyod pa'i skyes bu ni/ /kun bzang yum dang dbye ru med/ /ḍā ki lus dang grib mar 'grogs/ /zhes pas/ 'di nyid ston pa'i bla ma de yang*/ mkha' 'gro dngos yin pas gus pa mchog tu bskyed par bya zhing mkha' 'gro'i zab chos mkha' 'gro ma yin pas 'chad cing spel bar mi nus pas/ de nyan pa'i snod kyang phal cher mkha' 'gro 'du ba yin te/ grogs la'ang dag snang dang mos gus bskyed pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /dogs par ma byed cig /'di ltar bdag kyang sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i mtshan ltas thun mong ma yin pa 'ga' dang ldan pas mkha' 'gro 'du zhing zab gter la dbang ba yin no/ /gnyis pa chos kyi che ba brjod pa ni/ dus brtag pa las/ e ma gsang sngags mthar thug snying po'i chos/ /theg pa rim dgu'i nyams len don rdzogs 'di/ /kun las khyad 'phags e ma ngo mtshar che/ /bod yul kun tu gter phran bye ba sbas/ /gter chen brgya dang nyer brgyad sar sbas kyang*/ /gdams pa'i mthar thug 'di min sbas re kan/ /zhes pa dang*/ me long las/ e ma ho/ /'di 'dra'i gdams pa rgya bod gnyis na med/ /kun la ma bstan rang nyid nyams su longs/ /tshig tsam rlung gi phyogs su zag pa na/ /tshe yi bar chad byed par the tshom med/ /'di rang nyid kyis nyams su len pa dang*/ /ḍā ki nyid la gtad de gter du sbos/ /las can cig gi don du smon lam thob/ /ces so/ /gsum pa lta ba'i tshul bshad pa ni/ de nyid las/ gang gis 'di nyid lta ba'i dus su yang*/ /tshogs dang gtor ma rgya cher byas la blta/ /'di yi rlung gi phyogs kyi sems can yang*/ /ḍā ki rnams kyis byin rlabs bde ba thob/ /'di la reg pa o rgyan nga dang mnyam/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa gter 'byung gi lo rgyus bshad pa ni/ rgyal pos slob dpon bod du gdan drangs nas/

dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs te dga' ston mdzad pa'i dus su/ mchims phur tshogs kyi 'khor lo brgya rtsa brgyad btang ba dang*/ rgyal po'i sras mo pad+ma gsal dus las 'das pa la rgyal pos mya ngan mdzad pa la/ slob dpon yab yum gyis thugs gsos te/ /bu mo'i rnam shes bkug nas dbang bskur te/ / zab gter gyi sgrom bu spyi bor bzhag nas/ ma 'ongs pa na rang gzhan la phan pa'i smon lam btab nas gter du sbas pa'o/ /'di la ston pa dang bstan pa phun sum tshogs pas spyir bstan/ bsdu ba po dang gnas phun sum tshogs pa bye brag tu bshad/ dus dang skal ldan phun sum tshogs pa rgya cher bsngags pa gsum las/ dang po nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul rang byung pad+ma'i sdong po la rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas te/ gzho stod te sgro'i tshogs khang chen mor mkha' 'gro snying thig gi gdams pa gsungs la/ sngon 'byung gi g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug tu grub pa brnyes pa ste/ don gsal las/ o rgyan pad+ma bdag gis su/ /g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug tu/ /'di nyid bsgoms pas zag bcas phung po yal/ /zag med sgyu ma'i phung po la/ /snang la ma grub skye 'chi bral/ /'di nyid gang zag spros med kyi/ /blo can mya ngan 'da' don du/ /g.ya' ri gong du yi ger btab/ /rgyud dang gdams pa kun khyer te/ /'gro ba'i don du bod la mchis/ /zhes so/ / 'di'i dus su snying thig gi gdams pa 'di dus la ma babs pas gter du sped par dgongs pa ni/ de nyid las/ mnga' bdag rgyal po la sogs pa/ / skal ldan las 'brel mang lags kyang*/ /'di nyid bstan pa'i dus ma babs/ /bi ma mi tra 'byon dgongs nas/ /tshig tsam rlung phyogs tsam du yang*/ /'di nyid tshig tsam bshad pa med/ /phyi rabs skal ldan don byed du/ /dngas lung ldang lha'i brag la sbed/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa mkhar chen 'tsho rgyal gyis bsdu ba po byas te/

dngas lung khra mo brag la gter du sbas pa ni/ de nyid las/ mtsho rgyal khyod la gtad pa ni/ ku su lu yi gdams pa'i skor/ /dngas lung ldang lha'i brag la sbos/ /da lta bstan pa'i dus ma babs/ /zhes so/ /mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i gdams pa spros pa gal che ba bum thang na yod par/ de nyid las/ bco brgyad rgyud dang gdams par bcas/ /ma 'ongs skal ldan don du ni/ /bum thang seng ge'i brag la sbos/ / snyigs mar 'gro don rgya cher 'byung*/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa yang de nyid las/ tshe lo lnga bcu kha ral dus/ /gsal rje gangs kyi shar phyogs ngos/ /lcags sgrom lta bu'i yul gyi stod/ /'brong po nyal 'dra'i spyi stengs su/ /mkha' 'gro sde lngas byin rlabs pa'i/ /chu khams 'brug gam sprel yos lo/ /spre ring theg chen chos la mos/ /sbas tshul 'khor ba'i cha 'dzin cing*/ /ma 'gags spyod pa sna tshogs skyong*/ /da lta'i lha lcam pad+ma gsal/ /snyigs ma'i dus su de ltar skye/ /de dus gdams pa 'di dang 'phrad/ / zab mo'i gter dang 'phrad pa'i rtags/ /snying thig thabs kyi cha yin phyir/ /de yi dngos su mthong ba'i rtags/ /brla g.yas pa yi nang logs na/ /sha sme mkha' 'gro'i spyan 'dra yod/ /de ltar mtshan rtags rdzogs pa yis/ /las ldan skye bu de dang 'phrad/ /de dus 'gro don mi 'byung ste/ /phyi ma 'gro don brgya log spyod/ /dri med 'od zer zhes byar grags/ /gter gyi sgo 'byed bstan pa skyong*/ /lho yi phyogs su nges par 'byung*/ /ldang lhas bka' yi bya ra gyis/ /rtags dang ldan pa de la gtod/ /ces pa dang*/ snod dang dus brtag pa las/ nga yi thugs sras shes rab blo dang ldan/ /ḍā

ki'i spyan mtshan don gyi snying rje can/ /pad+ma las 'brel rtsal dang 'di 'phrad shog /de la dad mos 'dud tshad las can yin/ / rtag tu 'grogs pa rnams la smos ci dgos/ /'di la 'brel tshad bde ba can du skye/ /gang zhig skye ba dman pa'i bud med kyang*/ /'di 'phrad mi lus de yis ngan song khegs/ /rtag tu 'grogs rnams bde chen mkha' spyod yin/ /gang zhig sdig spyod smod cing skur 'debs rnams/ /'di dang dus mtshungs 'khor ba mtha' yod yin/ / ci'i phyir de yi thugs rjes nges par skyob/ /ces pa dang*/ ḍā ki'i zhal gdams las/ bdag 'dra o rgyan thugs kyi sras/ /ma 'gags spyod pa sna tshogs spyod/ /lus la sha sme spyan 'dras mtshan/ /sgeg par ches la spyod pa rtsing*/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dang 'phrad shog /de la 'dud byed ḍā ki'i sras/ / rmis ltas tshang ba bzhi 'byung bas/ de la gnad kyi gdams pa gtad/ /gzhan la tshig gcig brjod na 'phung*/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ḍā ki'i bu/ /sha sme spyan 'dras mtshan pa de'i/ /lus dang grib bzhin ḍā kis skyob/ /phrin las dus la ma babs pas/ /de la 'dud byed shin tu nyung*/ / 'di la mos tshad ḍā ki'i bu/ / sprul pa yin par ngas lung bstan/ /'di la mos byed skyes pa rnams/ /dpa' bo sde lnga'i sprul pa yin/ /'di la zab chos lus kyi 'brel/ /phyi ma de yi gdul byar skyes/ /skyes pa pho mo gang yang rung*/ /'di dang lhan cig 'grogs pas kyang*/ / yon tan sna re phyi mar 'thob/ /pho mo gang yang rung bas su/ /'di dang rtag tu 'grogs pa des/ /'di nyid 'das pa'i tshul bstan tshe/ /skyes bu de yi spyi bo nas/ /g.yu yi bud med rgyan drug can/ /'ja' tshon lta bu mkhyid gang ba/ /phyag na me tog dmar po bsnams/ /phaṭa kyi sgra 'byin nam mkha' la/ /bun kyis gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /de yi snying la las kyi gdung*/ /sngon po sran ma tsam gcig 'byung*/

/las can cig la snang srid dam/ /gal te ḍā ki'i gdan 'dren 'gyur/ /gdung rus gcig la yi ge hrīḥ 'byung 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /'ja' 'od ring bsrel 'byung yang srid/ /phal cher rtags med sbas tshul 'da'/ /dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa dgu la/ /ḍā ki rnams kyis gdan 'dren 'gyur/ /de ni dri med 'od zer zhes/ /ma 'ongs dus na lho ru 'byung*/ /las can de dang kun 'phrad shog /ces so/ /gsum pa smon lam gyis mjug bsdu ba ni/ klong gsal las/ yid bzhin nor bu'i gsang rgyud 'di/ /las can rnams dang ma 'ongs 'phrad/ / ces pa dang*/ don khrid las/ e ma ho/ yang gsang snying thig mngon sum man ngag 'di/ /gang gis reg pa myang 'das dngos la sbyor/ /theg brgyad a ti thig le skor gsum gyis/ /'di nyid don la reg pa ma yin no/ /mig stong shes rab grub mtha' mang po dang*/ /rgyud lung man ngag mang yang 'di mi mthong*/ /gzhan dang mi 'dra yang zab mngon sum gnad/ /'di dngos bstan cing bshad pa ci ma tshang*/ /tshig tsam rlung gi phyogs su brjod pa min/ /shes rab blo ldan snying rje can dang 'phrad par shog /'di la reg tshad lhag med 'grub par shog /ces so/ /de ltar zab cing rgya che'i gang chen mtsho/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig bka' gsang rgya che las/ /phyi rabs skal ldan rnams kyi don ched du/ /zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi snying po 'di/ /gangs ri thod dkar rin chen snying po'i mgul/ /dri med 'phags pa'i bzhugs gnas o rgyan rdzong*/ /shin tu dben zhing nyams dga' rig 'dzin gnas/ /lha dang drang srong mang pos brten pa der/ /dri med 'od zer bdag gis 'di byas pa'i/ /dge ba ston ka'i zla ltar dkar ba des/ /'gro kun yid mkha'i mun pa kun bsal nas/ /lhun grub sa la kun tu bzang por shog /nyi ma zla ba lhun po rgya mtshor bcas/ /sa chen gling bzhi'i 'jig rten gnas kyi bar/ /chos tshul 'di yang 'gro ba'i don byed

cing*/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan yun du gnas par shog /lha dang lha min grub pa rig sngags 'chang*/ /dpag med mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ / sngon bzhin zab mo'i dgongs gter yongs gzung ste/ /skal ldan rnams la rgyun du snang bar shog /rgyu 'bras gtsor len blau chung log lta can/ /bla mar mi gus chos dang nyams len 'chal/ /skal med rnams kyis dpe tsam mi mthong zhing*/ / rlung phyogs tsam du tshig tsam mi thos shog /dad dang snying rje gtong phod yangs pa che/ /mi gus med cing bla ma ci mnyes byed/ /phyi ma don gnyer tshe 'di bor ba'i mi/ /skal ldan snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog /kye ho grogs dag snying po'i don mthong nas/ /rin chen lus 'dis srid mtshor sgrol bzhin du/ /'jig rten chos la sbyong bar mi khom gyis/ /nyin mtshan brtson pas chos la spyod par shog /'gro drug nang nas mi lus rnyed par dkon/ /de bas chos dang 'phrad de spyod par dkon/ /de dag kun las snying po 'di 'phrad dkon/ /dben pa'i gnas su bsam gtan bsgom par shog /'jig par sla zhing snying po med pa'i lus/ /lbu ba rdos 'dra myur du mi rtag gis/ /grogs dag tshe 'di'i bya ba kun spangs la/ / chog shes ldan pas nags su bsgom par shog /bsags kyang 'jog la 'dus kyang 'bral ba'i chos/ /nor dang mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun la sogs pa'i/ / 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal 'di la gzigs/ /zhi ba'i nags su bsam gtan bsgom par shog /ji ltar snang ba thams cad gzugs brnyan tsam/ / bden pas stongs te brag cha'i sgra dbyangs 'dra/ /sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur shes byas nas/ /zab mo'i don la nags su bsgom par shog /skyes bu'i tshe 'gro ri gza' 'babs chu 'dra/ /'chi bdag mi sdod nub ri'i grib ma bzhin/ /skyes pa 'chi zhing 'dus pa 'bras ba'i chos/ /de ring nyid nas bsams te bsgom par shog / da res mi yi srid pa thob dus 'dir/

/thar pa'i gling du lam sna ma zin na/ /phyi nas gar 'gro bdag gis ji ltar shes/ /bde chen lam la btsan sa zin par shog /de skad phan par smra ba'i ngag 'di ni/ /snying nas yin gyis 'gro kun brtson par mdzod/ /rin chen gling nas stong log ma byed par/ /don zab snying po'i yid bzhin thob par shog /bdag kyang snyom las le lo'i rang bzhin dang*/ /rang don bslu ba'i gzhan don ltar snang gis/ /tshe 'dir grol ba'i 'od lus ma 'grub kyang*/ / bar do'i lus la brtan pa thob par shog /deng nas snga phyi'i skye ba thams cad du/ /rang byung pad+ma'i mgon dang bcas pa yis/ /'khor bar mi ldog mya ngan 'da' bar nges/ /gcig tu 'gro la phan par 'grub par shog /zab mo'i don mthong skye 'chi'i 'jig bral zhing*/ /bar do'i grol tshad mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag gi deng dus rang don bsgrubs zin gyis/ /da ni ci nas gzhan don byed par shog /sngon rabs skye ba du mar sbyangs pa'i mthus/ /zab mo'i don la blo mig rgyas gyur cing*/ /phyi nang grub mtha'i tshul rnams legs par mthong*/ /tshig don ma nor ji snyed ji bzhin bshad/ /skal ldan bung ba dga' bskyed skyed mos tshal/ /zab don sbrang rtsi'i snying pos gang ba 'di/ /legs sbyar me tog 'bras bu 'di smin pas/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'dod rnams tshul 'di bstan/ /bdag gi tshe 'dir phan pa rgya chung bas/ /ring por mi thogs sgyu ma'i lus 'di 'dor/ /bar do'i yul la zhing snang rgya che bas/ / lhun grub sa la btsan sa zin par shog /yang cig sprul pa'i 'od zer rab bkyes nas/ /thar ba'i gling du 'gro ba 'dren byed cing*/ /zab mo'i chos gter dpag med snang ba yis/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog / dpag med dus nas phan pa'i blo mnga' ba/ /rgyal sras spyod pa dam pa'i rjes zhugs te/ /mdzad pa 'phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pas/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog

/mkha' 'gro snying thig gi man ngag zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin zhes bya ba/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma yab yum gyis/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer zhes bya bas/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi ngos o rgyan rdzong gi gnas mchog dam par ston ka'i zla ba dang po'i me tog dang 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma 'od zer go chas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rgyud lung man ngag du ma'i snying po phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas bkod pa'i don rgya cher bshad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o// //dge zhing bkra shis/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (7)zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin/ -PAGE 336--PAGE 335--PAGE 191-
